description: 同じ名前 Probe と主手・副手・足の装備について版別の data get と storage コピーを観測する
setup: execute if data entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] HandItems run data merge entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] {CustomName:'"Probe"'}
execute unless data entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] HandItems run data merge entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] {CustomName:'Probe'}
item replace entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] weapon.mainhand with minecraft:stone
item replace entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] weapon.offhand with minecraft:dirt
item replace entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] armor.feet with minecraft:iron_boots

actions.run: data modify storage m2:entity name set from entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] CustomName
data modify storage m2:entity hand set from entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] HandItems
data modify storage m2:entity armor set from entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] ArmorItems
data modify storage m2:entity equipment set from entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] equipment
execute store result storage m2:entity health int 1 run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] Health
execute store success storage m2:entity get_CustomName int 1 run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] CustomName
execute store success storage m2:entity get_HandItems int 1 run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] HandItems
execute store success storage m2:entity get_ArmorItems int 1 run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] ArmorItems
execute store success storage m2:entity get_equipment int 1 run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] equipment
execute store success storage m2:entity get_equipment_mainhand int 1 run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] equipment.mainhand
execute store success storage m2:entity get_equipment_offhand int 1 run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] equipment.offhand
execute store success storage m2:entity get_equipment_feet int 1 run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,limit=1] equipment.feet
execute store success storage m2:entity name_matches int 1 if entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=probe,name=Probe,limit=1]
